note: Reusable v17 E2E token (replaces the old V16E2E fixture -- its mint authority was spent). Do NOT re-deploy the token genesis on every run. Mint fresh token_units from mint_authority_outpoint (cheap); after each mint, update mint_authority_outpoint to the new continuation ':0'. Only deploy a fresh genesis (kob-cli token create) if this file is missing or mint_authority_outpoint is spent. token_units are minted per-run because a cancelled sell unlocks its tokens back to KAS (KOB model), so they are not long-lived UTXOs to persist.
